描述_EN: this hu was probably one of the great numbers of bronzes cast as altar vessels for buddhist and daoist temples. the inscription tells us that the vessel was made at the city of zhenjiang. the form of the bronze and the style of both decoration and inscription are consistent with a song date. it is both an important documentary piece and an example of average quality song bronzework. it is covered with bands of delicate and intricate patterns that show the influence of both ancient and contemporary design. this vase, of a form known in chinese as hu, has a punched inscription running round its lower body dating it to a time - about 1173 - in the song period.
描述_ZN: 此胡可能是为佛教和道教寺庙铸造的大量青铜器中的一件。 铭文告诉我们，该器皿是在镇江市制造的。 青铜器的形式、装饰和铭文的风格都与宋代一致。 它既是一件重要的文献资料，也是一件质量一般的宋代青铜器的例子。 它上面布满了精致而复杂的花纹，显示了古代和现代设计的影响。 这个花瓶，在中国被称为 "胡"，它的下半身有一个冲孔的铭文，可以追溯到宋代的某个时期--大约1173年。
